paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: Paper sets 90% C.L. limits on axioelectric coupling g_Ae (AxionElectron) for ALP absorption, as well as dark photon kinetic mixing kappa, DM-electron cross section, and sterile neutrino mixing |Ue4|^2. The g_Ae limit improves existing constraints for masses between 0.03 keV/c^2 (30 eV) and 0.2 keV/c^2 (200 eV). However, no numerical values of g_Ae are given in the text; the exclusion curve is only shown in Fig. 2, which is not numerically tabulated. Local DM density assumed = 0.3 GeV/(c^2 cm^3), Standard Halo Model, escape velocity 544 km/s, v0 238 km/s. Coupling type is unambiguous but data points cannot be extracted from text. | Vision: Traced solid red DarkSide-50 (2022) curve from the g_Ae (axion-like particle) panel. X-axis is m_A in keV/c2 (converted to eV: 0.04-20 keV). Note the provided calibration referred to the sigma_e cross-section plot, not the g_Ae plot; readings here use the actual g_Ae panel axes. Sharp kink at ~0.25 keV and ~3 keV reflect spectral features. | Calibration: No calibration needed
